role: ground-photo out-of-distribution demonstration; not the flagship research result
sample_warning: Eight licensed Commons photos. This is not a Punggol census and must not be read as a city-scale thermal-affordance map. Flagship TCIS uses the Alienware 92,233 JPEG store; the full run finished on ual-chark (RTX 5090).
citation: Yang, S. et al. (2024). Thermal Comfort in Sight: Thermal Affordance and its Visual Assessment for Sustainable Streetscape Design. https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11887
notes: Photos are redistributable Commons files already in the streetview fixture.
TCIS weights are not committed. Full mode downloads them to the user cache.
VATA is visual thermal affordance, not measured personal comfort and not UTCI.
